name: Jottoma
author: Lorentz Barstad
description: Visualizes Jottacloud backups from jotta-cli: backup state, per-folder freshness and upload progress, storage split, quick pause, resume and scan controls, and desktop notifications for sync folder changes.

barWidget.description: Jottacloud backup status, freshness, uploads and storage.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often jotta-cli is polled while the panel is closed. It polls every 3 seconds while open.

schema.label: Warn after (hours)
schema.description: Flag the bar icon when a backup folder has not completed in this many hours.

schema.label: Pause duration
schema.description: How long the pause switch pauses jottad, e.g. 30m, 1h, 6h30m.

schema.label: Sync notifications
schema.description: Show a desktop notification summarizing each sync of the Jottacloud sync folder.
